== Title ==
<span lang="ja">完全防備の壁</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">相手がキャラクターか宇宙船を配備した直後に使用する。1フォース消費すること。そのキャラクターまたは宇宙船は、このターンの間中、戦闘と移動を行うことができない。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">無計画にデス スターから脱出しようとした一行は、ゴミ圧縮装置の磁気反射ドアに阻まれた。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Imperial Barrier]].

'''Lore''' — The party that tried to escape the Death Star without a plan was blocked by the trash compactor's magnetic-reflection door.

'''Game text''' — Use immediately after the opponent deploys a character or starship. Use 1 Force. That character or starship cannot battle or move for the rest of this turn.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Lore names a magnetic-reflection door, not a magnetically sealed door. Game text is play after opponent deploys, then spend 1 Force.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-D-imperialbarrier.gif|Original English face]], [[Imperial Barrier]].</ref>
